newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shot dead in row over parking space.
newsitem.headline: Russian shot dead in row over parking space.

text.p: A Russian dentist killed another driver after a row over a parking space on Sunday night, Moscow police said on Monday.

A spokesman said the middle-aged dentist shot the other driver dead after a heated argument over who was to park his car at the parking lot in southern Moscow. A few hours later the dentist handed himself over to police.
Gangland shootouts have become common in Moscow, the victims usually being involved in banking or business.
